args.note:
[placeholder] "Rift Basin" is the overview's title, not an approved name.

Act I region. A closed (endorheic) rift basin modelled on the Danakil Depression / Dallol, about 100 km rim to rim. Escarpment and highlands to the west and north-west; the city's upper city on a shelf in the escarpment directly above its Slums, at the foot of the falls; mineral washes and the Ruined Outpost mid-basin; basalt to the north under an active volcano; fossil reef terraces and gypsum stepping east to the salt flats and brine pools; localized acid pits at the south of the floor; the Dead Spring to the south.

Locked: zone 01 is the caravan escape tutorial (combat); zone 02 is the Slums, the safe quest hub (no combat). Anchors: Slums, upper city (4-6 combat maps for the finale), Acid Pits, destroyed ruins, captive-caravan intro.

Provisional: about 15-20 playable maps. The working 19-section scaffold groups them as 01 caravan escape, 02 Slums hub, 03-04 ruined road and ruins, 05-06 iron-stained washes, 07-08 basalt, 09-10 fossil terraces and gypsum, 11-12 salt flat and brine margin, 13-14 acid pools, 15-19 upper-city ascent to the final fight. Order, names and routes between zones are undecided; each zone is an ARPG tileset, so the map draws no zone-to-zone paths.

Story bible (ARPGStoryBible): Index · Act I · Geological blueprint
